name: Chancellor
source:
The second-in-command of the mysterious secret society known as C.R.O.W.N. that's pursuing the protagonist. 

He normally resides in the old castle that serves as the base of operations and almost never appears outside.

He does whatever it takes to accomplish his mission and views everything as a tool to achieve his goals.

Hometown: Liechtenstein
